##### Project General Facts

Marbella is a masterpiece of design, boasting an exquisite Andalusian-inspired aesthetic that embodies the essence of refined living, with premium townhouses that exemplify elegance and poise. The townhouses feature smooth white exteriors, large windows, and earthy wooden patterns, creating a sense of warmth and sophistication, while the interior finishing showcases modern finishing with high-quality materials, complemented by a timeless design that incorporates fresh, warm tones, and calm, relaxed atmospheres. The townhouses present an exceptional living experience, with lush living spaces that seamlessly transition into private areas, striking a perfect balance between elegance and functionality.

Marbella features an array of amenities, including an olive tree garden, where couples can tie their hearts together in a romantic setting, cheered on by the singing of European forest birds, as well as a beautiful Flamenco garden, where residents can discover the joy of this highly expressive form of art. The innovative pop-up malls that constantly appear throughout the hub keep things fresh with the latest in fashion, gadgets, and all else that brings joy, creating a vibrant and dynamic atmosphere. The emphasis on outdoor spaces and lush living areas creates a unique and desirable living environment, with an abundance of space for creating cherished memories.

The townhouses at Marbella offer ample space, both indoors and outdoors, providing the perfect backdrop for creating lasting memories and a life of comfort, with beautiful layouts and state-of-the-art finishes. The large windows serve as the perfect picture frames for a living landscape, and the glory of the Marbella hubs is yours to see from your abode. The air of peace and tranquility in the air extends itself within the townhouses, creating a sense of serenity and tranquility, making Marbella the perfect destination to come home to.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Lagoons is a location that offers a tranquil and peaceful atmosphere, with its proximity to key arterial freeways such as Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road, providing easy access to the city's main amenities. The area is surrounded by numerous landmarks, including the Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club, Dubai Autodrome, and Miracle Garden, offering a wide range of sports and leisure activities. The nearby hospitals, including Aster Medical Centre, Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, and NMC Royal Hospital, provide residents with convenience and peace of mind.

Damac Lagoons is also close to several top-rated schools, including Jebel Ali School, Fairgreen International School, and Global Indian International School, making it an ideal location for families. The area is served by several shopping malls, including First Avenue Mall, City Centre Meaisem, and Mall of the Emirates, offering a wide range of retail and dining options. The convenient location puts residents within minutes of the city's key amenities, including Al Maktoum International Airport, making it an ideal location for those who value convenience and accessibility.

The location of Damac Lagoons is hidden away along Hessa Street, right opposite DAMAC Hills community, providing a sense of seclusion and tranquility. The area is surrounded by numerous hotels, including Park Inn by Radisson, Studio One Hotel, and Five Hotel Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a wide range of accommodation options for visitors. The nearby Dubai International Stadium, Global Village, and IMG World provide a wide range of entertainment options, making Damac Lagoons a desirable location for those who value convenience, accessibility, and entertainment.
